Beneath Edron, two races of demons, the {creature:Shaburak Demon|Shaburak} and the {creature:Askarak Demon|Askarak}, have been at war since forgotten times. Players decide the course of the war: the difference in kills between the two factions at each server save makes one of them gain an advantage and summon Lords and, later, Princes. This world change gives you the chance to get the achievements **Shaburak Nemesis** and **Askarak Nemesis**.

1. Getting to the Demon Wars cave

If you are not in Edron, take a boat: talk to the captain at your city's port (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the **Edron** port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. From the port, head **north** to the Hero Cave entrance, north of the city.

Go to the {wiki:Hero Cave|Hero Cave}, **north** of Edron. Follow the usual path to the main floor, where many of the Hero Cave quests are: it is the **6th floor** of the cave (floor -6). The maps show each floor; bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel} for the holes.
Hero Cave, floor 6 (the one with the portal to the Demon Wars cave)

On the way you will meet {creature:Hero|Heroes}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians} and many other creatures.
On the main floor, enter the portal: you arrive in a safe room with the NPC {npc:A Dark Priestess}. In that room there are stairs that take you to the middle of the demon war cave.
The {creature:Askarak Demon|Askarak Demons} live to the **east**; the {creature:Shaburak Demon|Shaburak Demons} live to the **west**.

Go back to the stairs in the middle of the cave and go up to {npc:A Dark Priestess}'s safe room. From there, return to the Hero Cave the same way you came and go up floor by floor to the entrance, using the {item:Rope} on the holes you went down. Outside, head **south** to Edron; to leave the island talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the port ({key:hi}, the name of the city, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
Portal (main floor of the Hero Cave)
Ask any {wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC} about {key:demon war}. The answer shows the current phase:
Tie: neither faction has the advantage.
{creature:Shaburak Lord|Shaburak Lords} appear on the upper floors of the **west** tower.
{creature:Shaburak Lord|Shaburak Lords} and {creature:Shaburak Prince|Shaburak Princes} appear on the upper floors of the **west** tower.
{creature:Askarak Lord|Askarak Lords} appear on the upper floors of the **east** tower.
{creature:Askarak Lord|Askarak Lords} and {creature:Askarak Prince|Askarak Princes} appear on the upper floors of the **east** tower.

At {wiki:Server Save|server save}, the difference in deaths between the two factions is counted. There has to be a difference of **at least 100** for the war to advance to the next stage. If the war is tied and the difference is **greater than 400**, it jumps straight to the stage where the Princes appear.
